items.title: How a teen gamer and his mother helped rescue a missing girl
items.dek: When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping.

items.title: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
items.dek: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.
